text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was an Umamusume said to surpass 
even the one hailed as a "myth."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her name is Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...'Myth', huh? It's not like I was ever 
trying to surpass it."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
When I ran the way I wanted, people 
started feeling that way, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bolds and unexpected— that is how she 
dashes forward and seizes victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her rivals speak of her—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...A genius.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"You know, when we're running... sometimes 
it feels like there's a spotlight shining 
only on her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her rivals speak of her—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If I had to sum it up in a single 
phrase... ...a magnificent director, 
perhaps?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Her sheer innocence adds color to the 
turf. Her heart leaps with excitement, 
wondering what she will do today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to simply enjoying the 
race... honestly, I don't feel like I can 
beat her either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The Arima Kinen that still lingers 
fresh in our memories. We bore witness to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the "myth" behind and taking 
flight, she looked freer than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In the lead, Mr. C.B.! Mr. C.B. crosses 
the finish line in the lead!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The best in Japan is Mr. C.B., sir!
(Waaaaaahhh--!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—She didn't run for anyone else. Simply, 
freely, she enjoyed the race just as her 
heart desired.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that is why so many dreams were 
carried upon her back. Not as a second 
coming, but loved purely as herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
People say she is the peerless, naturally 
gifted Umamusume, a new “myth” 
incarnate—Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That was a special Mr. C.B. movie. See 
you all in the next video!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...That's what they say!

Some time after the Twinkle Series had 
ended, Mr. C.B. showed me a video.

It seems to be a video from 'Weekly 
Pakatto Channel,' run by that brown-haired 
young man.
choice_data_list: When did you get something like this...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
After the Arima Kinen was over, I bumped 
into them while out on roadwork.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So, she wanted to tell everyone about me 
to make amends for the trouble she caused.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I told them not to worry about it, but 
they were so eager that I just couldn't 
help myself!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, she said something 
pretty interesting during the shoot.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for everything. I got so 
caught up in my own dreams that I caused 
you an awful lot of trouble."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So it's fine, really. I didn't think it 
was a bother at all.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, um, that's not it... Well. ...I 
just wanted to say thank you."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: A thank-you?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"...If you hadn't told me back then that I 
could watch however I liked, I probably 
would have stopped watching races 
altogether."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe it's because I was only watching 
the races for the sake of my own dream."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure this is something I never 
would've understood if I hadn't run in the 
Twinkle Series, though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Just as races are a place for me to revel 
in that fiery passion—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
For the stands, a race is a place where 
they chase after that passion, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The people in the stands are watching 
their own dreams unfold through us.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this might just be the biggest 
revelation of the past three years.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
............ Well, not that it has 
anything to do with me!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm just gonna run however I like and have 
fun! So with that, I'm heading out for a 
stroll.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: See you tomorrow, Trainer.

Humming a tune, she walks down the hallway 
lit by the setting sun. Just by herself, 
wandering wherever her whims take her.
Mr. C.B.'s carefree journey never ends.
